claims.claim: The audit joins a lean crawl to GA4, GSC, and PageSpeed data, with near-duplicate, spelling, and semantic checks enabled.
Pages deeper than three clicks or with fewer than roughly five unique internal inlinks are investigation candidates.
A performance score below 80 is used as a prioritization threshold, followed by representative desktop/mobile inspection.
404s are prioritized only when joined to positive traffic, impression, click, event, or engagement evidence.
Thin and duplicate thresholds create review buckets rather than automatic expansion or deletion decisions.
Cannibalization requires the same topic and intent; a sales page and buyer guide can coexist.
Off-topic assets and weak clusters are reviewed against positive KPIs and topic-support depth.
Low impressions select the qualitative review set; established pages with no traffic, impressions, or backlinks are prune/rethink candidates.
Baseline placement and current topic relevance are audited, while a perfect optimizer score is explicitly unnecessary.
Positions 2-15 are low-hanging-fruit candidates and established position-50-plus queries can reveal missing dedicated pages.
Topic domination and citation auditing extend work to YouTube, Reddit, third-party SERP surfaces, and pooled AI citation sources.
Best-linked competitor pages reveal reusable formats that can be transferred across industries.
Static-corpus brand probing is only a rough observation because the model may hallucinate.
The speaker reports that a relevance refresh often lifts a page two to four positions.
